system.description:
“Trust nothing, not even your own eyes.” Your deity is a god of deception or an ancient trickster spirit. It twists your divine light into psychic energy. You summon a perfect illusory double of yourself to deceive enemies and punish their mistakes.

LEVEL 3

Smoke & Mirrors.

You know Illusion spells. You can only know 3 spell schools. Your Searing Light and Lifebinding Spirit can now deal Psychic damage instead. You can add +WIL to any skill checks to lie, deceive, cheat or "prank".

Duplicitous Spirit.

Your Lifebinding Spirit takes the form of a perfect illusory double of yourself and is considered an illusion. You can cast spells as if you were in the spirit's place, though you use your senses. When a creature would see through your double, it only means they can clearly tell the difference between you and it.

Illusory Double. Your Lifebinding Spirit is still Ethereal and immune to harm. It follows all normal illusion rules and has every sensory element that you normally would. When a target that can see through your double looses sight of both you and a spirit of yours or you swap places with a spirit, it can no longer tell the difference.

LEVEL 7

Who's Who?.

When you Move you can instead swap places with your Lifebinding spirit if its active.

LEVEL 11

Tricksy Ally.

While your Lifebinding spirit is adjacent to an enemy, allies with 1 space of it have advantage on melee attacks.

LEVEL 15

Triple Trouble.

You create 2 Lifebinding Spirits when using Duplicitious Spirit. They share any usage charges and you command both with the same action, though you can issue different commands.

Sacred Graces

  • Bend the Light. You can use Searing Light to become Invisible and Hidden, WIL turns, though it deals no damage or restores HP.
  • Protective Light. You can use Searing Lighting to give a Bloodied ally in Reach 6 WIL d8 temp HP that lasts until the end of their next Safe Rest.
  • Blessing Light. You can use Searing Light to imbue an ally's next weapon attack. It deals + WIL d8 Radiant damage.
  • Shifting Light. You can use Searing Light to swap the spaces of two willing allies in Reach 6. This deals no damage and restores no HP.
